searchText: hey! I've been slightly out of the loop regarding phase 2 architecture. Is the possibility of having custom wasm blobs totally off the table, and is it purely due to speed issues surrounding BLS on an interpreter ? <@322222239850168331> who said there were speed issues with BLS on an interpreter? 🤨 Perhaps i misinterpreted that ! What was the reason for the change in direction I don't think there was a change in direction. Are there still going to be EE's? Please define what EE means 😉 People have widely different understanding what they are and this makes communication rather hard, at least for me to be able to say yes or no to "will EEs exist". like eth1x64 looks to be a replacement to previous ewasm research Eth1x64, perhaps not clearly enough, but stated that it only serves as a tool to reason and explain designs on a much smaller scale and to engage dapp developers much more earlier for feedback. We still plan to work on a design next with wasm and bigger changes than what eth1x64 permits. Want to compare these approaches. Also think that results from account abstraction will have a significant impact on this, so would be wise to take that into account before making a material decision on phase2. 👍
